description:
Eoin O’Neill Property Advisers are delighted to present No. 67 Upper Leeson Street. This exceptional property will be coming to the market shortly. Interested parties are invited to register their interest in advance to receive further details and viewing arrangements.

This elegant and exceptionally bright Victorian property, extending two storeys over garden level, enjoys a prime position on one of Dublin 4’s most sought-after residential terraces. The property is presented in superb condition throughout and retains a wealth of original period features.

At the hall level, a gracious reception hallway sets the tone and leads to two beautifully proportioned interconnecting reception rooms, ideal for both formal entertaining and everyday living. At the garden level, the accommodation flows seamlessly into a stunning open-plan kitchen and family living space. This level is further complemented by a guest bedroom, a shower room and a well-appointed utility room.

At the first-floor level, there are two generous double bedrooms, both benefiting from en-suite facilities. A charming fourth bedroom benefitting from a balcony overlooking the rear garden, located on the hall floor return, while a spacious family bathroom completes the accommodation.

Externally, the property is equally impressive. To the front, a professionally landscaped setting provides ample off-street parking for up to three cars. To the rear, a beautifully maintained south-facing garden bordered by attractive cut granite walls.

The location is second to none, with a wealth of amenities within a short stroll, including St Stephen’s Green and Grafton Street. The nearby villages of Ballsbridge, Donnybrook and Ranelagh further enhance the appeal, offering an excellent selection of boutique shops, cafés and restaurants, while Fitzwilliam Lawn Tennis Club is conveniently situated just across the road.
